name: Northern Great Plains Program
summary: Grants for conserving and restoring grasslands and grassland wildlife in four Great Plains focal areas, including tribal prairie restoration, easements and habitat work. The 2026 round has closed.
reporting: Grantees pick the metrics that fit their project from the programme's list in NFWF's Easygrants system and report against them.

eligibility.rule: Is a 501(c) nonprofit, government agency, Tribal agency or educational institution
Not a business or unincorporated individual
The project directly and measurably contributes to one or more program priorities
No legal-compliance efforts except projects improving existing baseline compliance

documents: Board of Trustees or Directors list
GAAP audited financial statements, if not current in Easygrants
IRS Form 990, if not current in Easygrants
Single Audit, if not current in Easygrants

geography.quote: The following are the Northern Great Plains focal areas; Dakota Grasslands, Missouri-Milk River Grasslands, Nebraska Sandhills, and the Powder River-Thunder Basin Grasslands.

access.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Wednesday, February 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

effort.quote: Full Proposal Due Date Wednesday, February 25, 2026, 11:59 PM ET

eligibility.quote: Eligible applicants include non-profit 501(c) organizations, U.S. Federal government agencies, state government agencies, local governments, municipal governments, Tribal agencies, and educational institutions.
Ineligible applicants include businesses and unincorporated individuals.
All proposals must specifically address how projects will directly and measurably contribute to the accomplishment of one or more of the program priorities

NFWF funds may not be used to support ongoing efforts to comply with legal requirements, including permit conditions, mitigation and settlement agreements. However, grant funds may be used to support projects that enhance or improve upon existing baseline compliance efforts.

after_award.quote: individual grants will be required to track relevant metrics from Table 3 for demonstrating progress on project activities and outcomes and to report out on them in their interim and final programmatic reports.
